title: Daily spending
intro: See what remains after the costs you enter. Use amounts for the same period. This is arithmetic, not a bank account or financial advice.
period: Which period are these amounts for?
currency: Amounts in Thai baht (THB). No currency conversion.
shortfall: Costs exceed the money entered by
zero: The costs and available money entered are equal.
limit: This includes only the amounts you enter. It does not check wages, debt, benefits or actual prices.
privacy: These amounts stay only in this open page, even when plan saving is on. Reloading or closing the page clears them. Lift does not send them anywhere.
error: Enter zero or a positive amount with up to two decimal places. Use English or Myanmar digits. The maximum per field is 9,999,999.99 baht.
empty: Enter at least one amount to calculate. Empty fields count as zero.
edit: Change the amounts and calculate again whenever you need. Nothing here is a recommended spending target.
